title: DepRisk findings (v1)
description: Output of 'deprisk match --format json': advisories that apply to the package versions in the scanned projects. Deterministic: no timestamps, no absolute paths. Text fields (summary, ids, severity) come from the advisory database and are untrusted data.

advisories.description: The advisory data the result was computed from.

source.description: File or directory name only, never a full path.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the advisory source (the file's bytes for a .zip or .json; a digest of per-file digests for a directory), lowercase hex.

count.description: Advisories with at least one NuGet entry that were used.

skippedInvalid.description: Records that could not be read. Greater than zero means vulnerabilities may be missing.

packagesScanned.description: Distinct package id and version pairs checked.

packagesSkipped.description: Distinct package versions that could not be parsed as NuGet versions and were therefore not checked.

findings.description: Sorted by advisory id, then package id, then version.

severity.description: The database's own rating (for example GitHub's CRITICAL, HIGH, MODERATE, LOW), if present.

scores.description: Published severity scores, for example a CVSS vector. Not interpreted by 'match'.

version.description: Normalized NuGet version of the installed package.

fixedVersions.description: Versions above the installed one that the advisory lists as fixed, ascending. The first is the smallest known upgrade. Empty if no fix is known.
